name: query_string
description: Get protein-protein interactions from STRING database for a gene with confidence scores
usage: from app.tools.biomni.database_connectors import query_string; result = query_string('EGFR', species=9606, min_score=400)

parameters.species: int — NCBI taxonomy ID (default 9606 for human)

returns: dict with keys: gene, interactions (list of {partner_gene, score, experimental_score, coexpression_score}), source
